DevOps Engineer, Saffron Bank — Dec 2025 - Present
Implemented automated infrastructure provisioning for a payments staging environment using Terraform and AWS, reducing environment setup time by ~70%. Containerized core microservices with Docker and deployed them to a Kubernetes cluster, improving deployment consistency and rollback speed. Automated build and deployment pipelines with Jenkins, integrating CI/CD checks and automated tests to cut release cycle time. Maintained Linux servers and base images, performed system hardening and routine patching. Instrumented services and cluster metrics with Grafana dashboards for latency and error-rate monitoring, enabling faster incident response. Worked in Agile sprints and collaborated with developers on configuration as code and blue/green deployment strategies.

Skills: Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, Docker, CI/CD, Jenkins, Linux, Grafana, Agile
